item.title: Prime Minister Calls on Members of Parliament to be Drug Tested Next - Samoa Global News
item.description: By: Leota Marc Membrere, Gvt Press. "Come do your test". Prime Minister La’aulialemalietoa Leuatea Polataivao Fosi Schmidt is challenging Opposition Leader Hon Tuilaepa Sailele Malielegaoi, and Member of Parliament Hon Lealailepule Rimoni Aiafi, to get drug tested. In December last year, La’aulialemalietoa had called for the implementation of mandatory drug testing for all of government.
